game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Archive variation 10: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for History/classification review.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 600, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Nested While Dungeon' (Week 4 slot 15), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
